def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))

    def longest(cells, horizontal):
        groups = {}
        for r,c in cells:
            key,pos = (r,c) if horizontal else (c,r)
            groups.setdefault(key,set()).add(pos)
        best = (0,None,None,None)
        for key,ps in groups.items():
            for p in ps:
                if p-1 not in ps:
                    n=0
                    while p+n in ps: n+=1
                    if n > best[0]: best=(n,key,p,p+n-1)
        return best

    # The long right-angle object encodes the paint color and orientation.
    marker_i = None
    marker_score = (-1,-1,-1)
    for i,(color,cells) in enumerate(comps):
        hl,vl=longest(cells,True),longest(cells,False)
        score=(min(hl[0],vl[0]),hl[0]+vl[0],len(cells))
        if hl[0]>=3 and vl[0]>=3 and score>marker_score:
            marker_i,marker_score=i,score
    if marker_i is None: return out
    marker_color, marker = comps[marker_i]
    hl,vl=longest(marker,True),longest(marker,False)
    # Intersect the dominant horizontal and vertical bars to locate the elbow.
    hr,hlo,hhi=hl[1],hl[2],hl[3]
    vc,vlo,vhi=vl[1],vl[2],vl[3]
    if not (hlo <= vc <= hhi and vlo <= hr <= vhi): return out
    # Determine the open diagonal quadrant opposite the two arms.
    down = hr == max(r for r,c in marker)  # horizontal arm points left/right from bottom
    right = vc == max(c for r,c in marker) # vertical arm is at right edge

        pts=[(r,c) for r,c in cells]
        variants=[]
        for flip in (1,-1):
            for rot in range(4):
                tmp=[]
                for r,c in pts:
                    x,y=r,flip*c
                    for _ in range(rot): x,y=y,-x
                    tmp.append((x,y))
                mr=min(x for x,y in tmp); mc=min(y for x,y in tmp)
                variants.append(tuple(sorted((x-mr,y-mc) for x,y in tmp)))

        if i==marker_i: continue

            if j==marker_i or keys[i]!=keys[j]: continue

                cmin=min(c for r,c in cells); cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
                # Target copy lies in the open quadrant beyond the elbow.
                in_open = (rmin>hr and cmin>vc) if dr>0 and dc>0 else \
                           (rmax<hr and cmin>vc) if dr<0 and dc>0 else \
                           (rmin>hr and cmax<vc) if dr>0 and dc<0 else \
                           (rmax<hr and cmax<vc)

        maxsize=max(x[0] for x in pairs)
        choices=[p for p in pairs if p[0]==maxsize]
        _,_,target=max(choices,key=lambda p:p[1])
        for r,c in comps[target][1]: out[r][c]=marker_color
    return out
